const styles = {
  registerPage: {
    minHeight: "100vh",
    width: "100%",
    display: "flex",
    justifyContent: "center",
    alignItems: "center",
    padding: "40px 20px",
    backgroundImage: `url(${hostelBg})`,
    backgroundSize: "cover",
    backgroundPosition: "center",
    backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
    backgroundAttachment: "fixed",
  },

  formContainer: {
    maxWidth: "600px",
    width: "100%",
    background: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)",
    backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
    WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
    borderRadius: "20px",
    padding: "40px",
    boxShadow: "0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
  },

  radioGroup: {
    display: "flex",
    justifyContent: "center",
    gap: "20px",
    marginBottom: "20px",
  },

  inputField: {
    width: "100%",
    padding: "14px",
    marginBottom: "18px",
    border: "1px solid #ddd",
    borderRadius: "10px",
    fontSize: "16px",
    outline: "none",
  },

  submitButton: {
    width: "100%",
    padding: "14px",
    background: "#6C4DF6",
    color: "#fff",
    border: "none",
    borderRadius: "10px",
    fontSize: "18px",
    fontWeight: "bold",
    cursor: "pointer",
    transition: "0.3s",
  },

  sectionTitle: {
    textAlign: "center",
    marginBottom: "30px",
    fontSize: "2.2rem",
    color: "#2d2d2d",
  },
};
